settings.heading: Free 7-day size exchange
settings.text: Wrong size? Swap it free within 7 days of delivery. We pick it up from your door.

settings.title: Raise a request
settings.text: Within 7 days of delivery, WhatsApp or email us your order number and the size you want.

settings.title: Free pickup
settings.text: We arrange a reverse pickup from your address. Keep the tee unworn, unwashed, with tags attached.

settings.title: Quality check
settings.text: Once it reaches us, we check it within 48 hours.

settings.title: New tee shipped
settings.text: Your new size ships right away. Refunds, where applicable, are processed in 5–7 working days.

Size exchange (free): within 7 days of delivery, once per order, on unworn and unwashed tees with tags attached, subject to stock. Pickup included.
Design or colour swap: also within 7 days, with a ₹99 pickup fee. If the new tee costs more, you pay the difference.
Combos: couple combos and bundle orders can be exchanged for size, not returned for a refund.
Damaged, defective or wrong item: tell us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and an unboxing video, and we'll replace it or refund you in full, including any COD fee.
Refunds: only for damaged, defective or wrong items. Prepaid orders are refunded to the original payment method; COD orders by UPI or bank transfer, or as store credit if you prefer.
Not eligible: worn or washed items, items without tags, custom-printed products, gift boxes, and the COD fee (except for our mistakes).

settings.question: Is the exchange free?
settings.answer: Yes, the first size exchange on every order is free, including the pickup. Swapping to a different design or colour has a ₹99 pickup fee.

settings.question: My pincode doesn't have reverse pickup. What now?
settings.answer: Ship it to us with any courier and we'll add up to ₹100 as store credit to cover the cost.

settings.question: Can I get a refund instead of an exchange?
settings.answer: Refunds are for damaged, defective or wrong items. For a different size we exchange it free; for anything else we can offer a swap or store credit.
